description: This file defines the EditNotebookDialog class, a UI component for editing or creating notebooks within an Android app, handling user input, validation, and interaction with the ViewModel.

classes.name: EditNotebookDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for editing or creating notebooks, managing user input, validation, and interaction with the ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, retrieves the Notebook object from arguments.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Creates and inflates the view binding for the dialog layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the dialog UI based on whether a notebook is being edited or created, sets up button actions and input focus.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the dialog with an optional Notebook argument.
